order: Alternate baseline/candidate and candidate/baseline on successive cases; fresh conversations. Same cases for both models.
primary_metric: Exact answer value, ignoring citation shape and extra JSON keys. Require parseable JSON object with answer of correct type; no answer repair. Compare both-correct pairs; exact two-sided McNemar, Holm over two models.
secondary: Grounded content: exact answer and expected citation IDs, accepting string IDs or singleton source_id objects; strict JSON score and missing-evidence errors reported separately.
gate: Adopt as optional only if both known Llama failures are correct in the regression run and holdout answer-value, grounded-content, strict and answer-pair counts do not fall on either model. Disclose individual regressions and whether fresh accuracy improved or merely stayed unchanged. No holdout tuning.
workflow: Same model-generated query and final schema as v0.4. Code matches entity/field exactly and selects the unique highest INTEGER revision. Tied maxima fail. The model still copies the value and cites the source; no final-answer substitution or gold inputs. The tool now implements BOTH matching and revision-selection rules.
rules: No gold or pair metadata in requests, no retries, no output repair. Truncation is failure. Development excluded from holdout. Fixed settings do not guarantee bitwise determinism.
limitations: Same synthetic templates, one quantization per model, one machine; two calls per condition. The tool implements both matching and numeric revision selection. This benchmark mostly measures model query extraction and value/citation copying after tool use, not independent model reasoning. Known failures are reused regression fixtures, excluded from new-case results. No general intelligence or training claim.
